title: Faculty Centre Administrator
company: Newcastle and Stafford Colleges Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
FACULTY ADMINISTRATOR (Professional Studies)

Location: Stafford College
Contract: 37 hours per week, 12 month fixed term contract (maternity cover)
Salary: £26,244 - £27,031 per annum

Newcastle and Stafford Colleges Group (NSCG) is one of the very best colleges in the country. In October 2024 we became the first and only further education provider in England to achieve a full set of outstanding grades in consecutive Ofsted Inspections. This includes recognition of our strong contribution towards meeting Local Skills Needs under the latest version of the Education Inspection Framework (EIF).

The inspection report praised all areas of the College's provision and acknowledged NSCG's 'staff are professional, friendly, incredibly supportive and work tirelessly to meet the needs of learners' 'teachers improve their practice based upon the support they receive' and 'teachers create highly supportive, calm and highly aspirational environments in which learners and apprentices thrive'. ' In summary, NSCG is a great place to work and study.

To read the full Ofsted report for Newcastle and Stafford Colleges Group, please visit the Ofsted Government website, select Find an Inspection Report and search for Newcastle and Stafford Colleges Group.

The group is currently home to a population of over 6,500 full-time students with around 2,000 adult learners and students on higher education programmes. We have over 1,500 apprentices where we work with over 850 individual employers. Our Sixth Form provision has a reputation for high academic achievement and excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated, enthusiastic and suitably qualified individual with excellent communication and organisational skills to take on this role within Faculty of Professional Studies.

Reporting directly to the Director of Professional Studies you will be responsible for providing a comprehensive support service to staff throughout the department.

Duties are varied and include monitoring budget expenditure and allocations, processing orders, invoices and payments, processing student application forms, supporting course advice events, working with data, checking exam entries as well as dealing with correspondence and as the main contact point for enquiries you will liaise with students, parents, staff and employers.

In addition to a good standard of general education, you should have a relevant business admin qualification along with previous experience of working in a varied and busy administrative and/or secretarial role. You will have a confident manner with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels, excellent MS Office Skills (Word, Excel and Access) and will be able to work efficiently to tight deadlines. Hours of work are usually office hours Monday to Friday, but occasional attendance at open evenings and parents evenings will be required.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:
- With the support of the wider Professional Studies administration team, act as the initial point of contact for all enquiries from students, parents and teachers.
- Handle cash where appropriate complying with the College's Financial Regulations.
- Support the Director of Professional Studies with the planning and coordination of exams, assessments, and mocks exams.
- Assist the Director of Professional Studies and Curriculum Manager with the planning of student timetables and tracking of enrolments.
- To work with the Director of Professional Studies: to check data received from Information Services regarding student numbers, retention and achievement on course.

Required Skills and Experience:
- Has a good standard of education qualified to level 3 or equivalent and be willing to undertake any relevant professional development.
- Has previous experience of working in a varied administrative and secretarial role with outstanding organisational skills.
- Has a confident manner and able to communicate effectively at all levels showing professionalism to visitors and guests.

What's in it for you?

The college offers an excellent benefits package which includes:
- Employer Pension contributions - Local Government Pension Scheme
- 24 Days Annual Leave (plus Bank Holidays & Christmas Closure).
- Cycle to Work Scheme (Salary sacrifice).
- Subsidised Gym Membership.
- Health-related benefits including Subsidised Health Scheme.
- Excellent Training and Development Opportunities (supported with a dedicated budget).
- Staff Parking
- On site restaurant facilities and FREE early morning coffee/tea and toast

How to apply

To apply for the role of Faculty Administrator, please click 'Apply Now' to complete an online application form.

If you are applying via a jobs board, you will receive an email and link that will take you directly to our application form on the Newcastle & Stafford Colleges Group website).

Closing date completed applications: Wednesday 14 th October 2026
Interviews to be held: Thursday 22 nd October 2026

This college is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of young people and vulnerable adults and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All college-based positions are subject to enhanced DBS check and are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act.

As an equal opportunities employer, we welcome applications from all sectors of the community.

title: Recruitment Coordinator
company: XPERT RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Recruitment Coordinator
Full time Hybrid (must be local to Stoke on Trent) Monday - Friday 8.30am - 5pm
12-month fixed-term contract with a view for permanency
Stone
£30,000 + Benefits

Love recruitment, organisation and making sure everything just works?

We're looking for a Recruitment Coordinator to join the HR team on a 12-month fixed term contract, supporting the recruitment and onboarding journey from the moment a vacancy is approved right through to a new employee's first day.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone with experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, HR administration or a coordination role who enjoys being the person behind the scenes making sure candidates, hiring managers and new starters have a smooth and professional experience.

You'll be juggling vacancies, candidates, interviews, paperwork, pre-employment checks, onboarding and plenty of moving parts - so organisation is definitely your friend!

The Role
- Coordinating the recruitment process from vacancy approval through to appointment.
- Preparing and advertising vacancies across agreed recruitment channels.
- Managing candidate applications and keeping recruitment records accurate and up to date.
- Liaising with hiring managers around shortlisting, interviews and candidate feedback.
- Coordinating interviews and assessments, including diaries, venues and online meetings.
- Keeping candidates informed throughout the recruitment process and responding to queries promptly and professionally.
- Preparing offer letters, contracts and other recruitment documentation.
- Coordinating pre-employment checks including right to work and references.
- Managing new starter paperwork and ensuring all required information is received and recorded.
- Working with hiring managers to make sure new starters have everything they need for a successful start.
- Organising new starter inductions and onboarding arrangements.
- Coordinating equipment and other requirements, including laptops, iPads, cameras, access cards and more.
- Working with IT, operations and other teams to make sure everything is ready before a new employee walks through the door.
- Maintaining accurate recruitment and onboarding information across HR and recruitment systems.
- Keeping an eye on deadlines and proactively chasing outstanding actions - because nothing should be left sitting in someone's inbox gathering dust!
- Producing routine recruitment reports and information as required.
- Keeping recruitment templates, forms and candidate communications accurate and consistent.
- Supporting the wider HR team with recruitment projects and process improvements.
- Looking for ways to make recruitment and onboarding more efficient and, importantly, improve the candidate experience.

The Person

We're looking for someone who gets recruitment and gets people.

You'll ideally have previous experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, HR administration or a coordination-focused role, with a good understanding of the recruitment process.

You'll also bring:
- Excellent organisation skills and the ability to manage multiple vacancies, candidates and deadlines at once.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent attention to detail - especially when dealing with candidate information, contracts and pre-employment checks.
- A genuine focus on delivering a positive candidate experience.
- The ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
- Confidence communicating with candidates, hiring managers, colleagues and external contacts.
- Good IT skills and working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel.
- A proactive approach - you're someone who spots what needs doing and gets on with it.
- The ability to stay calm and organised when priorities change or things get busy.
- A collaborative approach, while also being comfortable managing your own workload.
- A positive, dependable and can-do attitude.

We're looking for someone who will take ownership, keep things moving and isn't afraid to pick up the phone, chase an answer and get things done.

Why apply?

Salary up to £30,000 per annum, depending on experience.

You'll also receive:
- 25 days' annual leave + bank holidays
- Company pension scheme
- Company sick pay scheme
- Social events throughout the year
- Company office shut-down between Christmas and New Year

If you're looking for a role where you can solve problems, take ownership and actually have an impact on how a business grows, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply now or get in touch with Jo Thompson - for more information.

Xpert Recruitment Ltd is acting as an employment agency on behalf of our client. By applying, you agree to register with us and consent to us holding your personal details on file. Due to the high volume of applications, we will only contact candidates who have been shortlisted for the role. However, we may also reach out regarding other suitable vacancies that match your profile.

title: Training & Development Coordinator
description:
Training & Development Coordinator

Stoke-on-Trent Hybrid 3 days on-site
£30,000 - £32,000
Permanent

Macmillan Davies is delighted to be working exclusively again with a national construction company to recruit a newly created Training & Development Coordinator role, joining the business at a really exciting time of growth and development.

With a new CEO, a developing HR team and new HR leadership in place, there is plenty happening across the organisation. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who wants to join a business where they can bring ideas, improve processes and genuinely help shape how Learning & Development is delivered.

The role

Reporting to the Training & Development Partner, you'll provide hands-on coordination and support across the full Training & Development agenda, with an immediate focus on embedding the newly introduced Learning Management System.

With the new LMS being launched around four weeks ago, you'll play an important role in supporting its continued implementation and helping managers and employees get the most from the system.

Previous experience supporting or managing an LMS implementation or rollout would therefore be particularly valuable. You don't need experience of large enterprise platforms such as Workday or Oracle, we're looking for someone comfortable working with a straightforward LMS who understands how systems, processes and great coordination can make learning more effective.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting the ongoing implementation and embedding of the LMS
- Coordinating internal and external training activity across the business
- Liaising with external training providers and managing course arrangements
- Supporting the creation, coordination and maintenance of training content
- Managing training records, certifications and associated administration
- Proactively following up with managers to ensure required training is completed
- Responding to manager and employee queries around the LMS and Training & Development
- Supporting the administration and coordination of apprenticeships
- Taking ownership of the employee onboarding process
- Supporting wider Training & Development projects and initiatives

Who are we looking for?

We're looking for somebody bright, proactive and organised who enjoys taking ownership

You'll ideally bring:
- Previous experience within Learning & Development, Training Coordination or a similar role
- Experience supporting, implementing or administering an LMS
- Strong organisation and coordination skills, with the ability to keep multiple activities moving
- Confidence liaising with managers, employees and external training providers
- Good attention to detail, particularly around training records and certifications
- A proactive approach to following up actions and ensuring things get completed
- Strong systems capability and the confidence to learn new technology

The Training & Development function is evolving, so there will be plenty of opportunity to bring ideas, improve how things are done and see the role develop over time.

If you're an L&D or Training professional who enjoys systems, coordination and making things better we'd love to hear from you.

title: Administrator
description: Would you like to become a member of ourPrimary Care Services administration team providing innovative care to our patient population as part of an outstanding CQC organisation? Do you have a background in Primary Health Care or Pharmacy environment OR experience working in centralised administration and are wanting to further develop your skills? Do you have good attention to detail and enjoy following administrative protocol to resolve patient queries? We are looking to appoint two highly motivated and experienced administrators to work within a centralised team across our three integrated practices Moorcroft Medical Centre, Holmcroft Surgery and Keele Health Centre. These posts support the admin function with particular focus on processing prescriptions. Each post is part time at 28hrs per week - worked across five days. The purpose of the role is to provide an effective, accurate, timely and qualitative service for processing prescription requests for registered patients. Support prescribing clinicians within the practice with regards to the issuing, reauthorising and managing of prescription administration. Assist and direct patients in effectively managing and ordering medications and resolving queries and issues as required. The ability to drive and be adaptable to the demands of the service is a must. We are a friendly and well organised team with a forward-thinking approach. Full training will be provided to support induction into the role. To undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the prescribing and long-term condition management processes within the Practice, In this vital role, you will ensure the safe, accurate, and timely processing of prescription requests while serving as a key liaison between patients, clinicians, pharmacies, and external healthcare providers. You will be responsible for managing medication queries and supporting medicines optimisation initiatives. Your work will directly contribute to improving patient care by ensuring seamless prescription workflows, resolving supply issues, and synchronising repeat medications. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values precision, and enjoys making a real difference in patient health and safety. Ensuring the smooth and efficient running of our reception area, working as part of our reception team. Acting as a first contact with the practice and being aware that you are an ambassador for our surgery. Application of registration procedure for new patients and their induction into the practice via booking of an optional new patient assessment and distribution of the practice information leaflet. Receiving patients at the desk and directing as necessary. Application procedures for temporary residents and those requiring immediately necessary treatment. Operation of the appointments system which will include booking of arrivals and negotiating suitable appointment arrangements with patients. Ensuring clinicians are made aware of patients requiring urgent assessment. Monitoring and managing the waiting area to ensure that patients are seen in a timely manner and within a safe environment. Processing patient queries appropriately and ensuring follow up. Processing and distribution of claim forms etc. Receipt and processing of medical mail, both postal and hand delivered in accordance with the protocol for processing the daily post. To understand the difference between repeat and acute prescriptions and deal with appropriately. Issuing and management of repeat prescriptions in accordance with our Repeat Prescribing Policy. To deal with patient requests for non-recurrent medication and liaise with the appropriate clinician for such requests. Operation of security protocol for stocks of prescriptions. Receiving specimens, ensuring that they are correctly labelled and identifiable and ensuring their appropriate distribution in accordance with our Health & Safety policy. Direct liaison with other services such as Pharmacies, community services etc. Sign-posting to services provided both in-house and externally.
